form: J17 fracture v1 (account D; draft until docs/methods/destruction_model.md lands)
character: A tired, overloaded regime truck held together by paperwork and paint: the door was always loose, the glass is cheap, the bolts were never torqued; only the welds the factory was proud of hold, and the missile sits on its bed under one tired strap.
units: sprite px of the intact picture, y down; outline = convex hull, points relative to the piece centre; mass = px area x areal density
breakOrder: 1 glazed + hinged: the cab glass shatters and the loose door swings on its last hinge, then drops
2 bolted: the side panels peel off the body frame (the frame's insides show); the rear wheels come off
3 bolted/strapped: the front wheels, the stabiliser leg, the fuel box under its strap; the chassis drops on its hubs
4 bolted/strapped: the bumper, the exhaust stack, the rear erector
6 welded: the cab tears off the frame (the engine shows), the tow hook goes with the bumper
7 resting: nothing holds the missile, it rolls off its bed
8-9 welded: rail, roof, frame and chassis stay as the burning wreck

states.intact: the intact sprite (or every piece in place)
states.damaged: damaged.png: cracks and lifted lips on the order 1-3 seams, the door sprung
states.wrecked: joints of order <= 7 broken; the pieces with stays/order 8-9 remain in place
